verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
You came to us a man
In very nature God
Pierced for our iniquities
As You hung upon the cross
But God exalted You
To the highest place
And gave to You the right to bear
The name above all names

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
At the name of Jesus, we should bow
Ev'ry tongue confess that You are Lord
And when You come in glory for the world to see
We will sing

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Hail to the King
In all His splendor and majesty
Hail to the King of kings
Lord Jesus our God

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
We eagerly await
The coming of the day
The glory of the risen King
Will shine upon the earth
Then rival thrones will fall
Before the Lord of all
And hail supreme authority
In the true and living God
